name: standings-table
title: Standings table
description: A league table: position, club, played, won, drawn, lost, goal difference and points, with form shapes and promotion and relegation zones named in words, not colour.
docs: Pass rows in table order: { team, logo, position, played, won, drawn, lost, for, against, points, form }. Position defaults to the place in rows, so rows that are already in order need none. Points are never worked out, because the rules differ; goal difference is for minus against and always shows its sign. form is the last results, oldest first, as 'WWDLW', ['W','D'] or the words win, draw and loss: the last five are drawn as a filled shape for a win, a hollow one for a draw and a dash for a loss, and read out as 'Last five: win, win, draw, loss, win'. zones ({ from, to, label, tone }) put a rule on the left of their rows (solid for positive, dashed for neutral, dotted and destructive for negative) and a line in the legend; a screen reader hears the zone after the club's name. highlightTeam names a club to single out with a star, a plate and the word 'highlighted'. The columns step aside as the box narrows, down to position, club, played and points, by container width and not by screen, and the crest steps aside below 22rem so a club's name is never clipped. It renders on the server. locale writes the figures and labels translates every word, including the column abbreviations and their full forms.
